summary.method: V30 two-tier read-moment ceiling, model-free, all 804. Read-moment=first coherent qualifying-ask descent (ask at running-min, >=10s dwell, >=5-lot) per leg, earlier of the pair. TIER A (oracle): roles ex-post from audited closes (PATIENT=lower close/faller, CHASED=higher close/riser); patient floor=first qualifying ask<=min(own_close-1,99-chased_maker_floor); chased buy-window=qualifying ask<=min(own_close-1,99-patient_maker_floor) after read. TIER B (callable): at read_moment, roles from decision-time tape signals in [read-180s,read] ONLY -- PATIENT=leg with higher D where D=ask_walk_down-bid_stack (ask walking into demand); CHASED=leg with bid-stacking under pinned ask. Tier B scored vs Tier A oracle. V30 ceiling = Tier A ceiling events whose roles are ALSO callable-correct at Tier B. Bell=audited close ts; scheduled from decision-trace t_minus_scheduled.
